local.reason: Local Objects contract has no database execution.

symbolic.reason: Expression construction and validation have no database execution. Lowered queries require separate per-provider tests.

planned.reason: Resolve versions from the provider matrix and run this case against each claimed version. No engine result is recorded.

other-provider.reason: Upstream signature belongs to a different provider extension surface. Portable equivalents require separate records.

cosmos.reason: This member belongs to the nonrelational Cosmos provider. The four relational engines do not expose this upstream contract.

source.execution: Adapt a source or construct a range. Defer item production where the input permits it.
source.contract: Prove finite versus infinite output, range bounds and overflow. Preserve source-specific ordering, replayability, cancellation and ownership.
source.cost: Streaming adapters can be constant-space. Measure retained input and any intermediate storage.

projection.execution: Apply local callbacks per demanded element.
projection.contract: Preserve encounter order. Check index origin, flattening order, type conversion failure and the exact consumed prefix.
projection.cost: Measure callback count and allocations per projected row. SelectMany may retain an active inner iterator.

partition.execution: Consume a specified prefix, suffix or window.
partition.contract: Test negative counts, from-end offsets, out-of-range access, last partial chunk, one-shot and infinite input. Count consumed items even when output is empty.
partition.cost: Prefix operators can stream. Suffixes, from-end forms and chunks may retain a window or require exhaustion.

cardinality.execution: Answer a positional, presence, count or aggregate question.
cardinality.contract: Distinguish absence, present zero and multiple values. Check vacuous All, Any, element bounds, predicate variants and short-circuit points.
cardinality.cost: A count may use a valid known size. First/Any may stop early. Single must check for a second match.

numeric.execution: Reduce items by seed, selector, order or numeric operation.
numeric.contract: Specify empty/all-null, missing seed, winner on ties, signed overflow, narrowing, NaN, infinity and decimal precision.
numeric.cost: Measure traversal and accumulator storage. Grouped aggregation also requires per-key state.

ordering.execution: Reorder input or refine an earlier ordering.
ordering.contract: Specify comparator laws, stable ties where guaranteed, direction and random permutation properties. Require finite input for whole-input reordering.
ordering.cost: Sorting generally buffers O(n) items and costs O(n log n). Measure reverse/shuffle separately.

set.contract: Specify multiplicity, first occurrence, order, compatible equality/hash semantics and typed nil. Concat emits all items. SequenceEqual compares aligned values.
set.cost: Record which input is indexed, early stop and maximum live keys. Pairwise custom equality can change complexity.

group-join.execution: Produce groups, joined pairs or per-key aggregates.
group-join.contract: Verify duplicate multiplicities, null/equal keys, unmatched presence, group and member order, seed and reducer contracts.
group-join.cost: Record lookup build side, retained keys and values, output expansion and first-result latency.

materialize.execution: Collect or deliver all requested results to a destination.
materialize.contract: Verify duplicate-key policy, nil and empty results, map key constraints, callback side effects and cancellation/producer shutdown for channels.
materialize.cost: Materializers retain distinct keys or output rows. Measure copies and output capacity.

composition.execution: Combine, align or augment ordered input streams.
composition.contract: Specify shortest zip input, default-on-empty behavior, append/prepend order and restart/early-stop access to each input.
composition.cost: Track live iterators, lookahead and callback count at cancellation or stop.

expression.execution: Build or traverse inspectable typed data.
expression.contract: Verify field ownership, operand typing, null lifting, registration, conversion and source spans. Fix the portable subset before freezing APIs.
expression.cost: Measure construction, validation and canonicalization separately from execution.

expression-review.execution: Classify a .NET expression member beyond the proposed core.
expression-review.contract: Assess CLR control flow, dynamic binding, reflection, mutation and code-generation dependencies. A supported alternative or a justified exclusion needs review per member.
expression-review.cost: No Go implementation or cost model selected.

server.execution: Compose or execute an explicit provider-backed plan.
server.contract: Respect upstream signature shape, null semantics, collation, stable pagination and command ownership. Check versioned dialect support before SQL or fail before retrieval.
server.cost: Record command count, returned rows, plan/cache effects, buffering and connection lifetime.

ef-extension.execution: Bind a provider or EF-specific operation to model context and query scope.
ef-extension.contract: Review tracking/filters/includes, SQL parameters, temporal semantics, raw SQL, bulk DML or compiled-query semantics as applicable to the signature. Validate each provider independently.
ef-extension.cost: Measure actual command counts and materialization effects. Dialect goldens alone cannot establish result equivalence.

objects.boundary: Local callbacks operate only after explicit materialization or an error-aware stream boundary.

expressions.boundary: Symbolic construction is independent of materialization. A lowered query requires explicit validation.

queryable.boundary: Validate on the server path. A translation failure sends zero commands. Switching to local processing requires an explicit boundary.

acceptance.gap: Each overload needs a reviewed Go signature, an overload-specific case and executable evidence. No public API, provider version or benchmark has been certified.
